question: Should Crabpot accept QQBot commit `47142c9` only after the isolated fixture is repaired and validated, or intentionally retain the existing validated pin and close this Dependabot PR?
rationale: The failed compatibility check blocks a mechanical merge, while the recent close request suggests the upstream revision may no longer be desired; only a maintainer can choose the supported QQBot compatibility target.

options.title: Withdraw this bump

options.title: Validate and land the new revision
options.body: Update the fixture expectations as needed, make the isolated QQBot check pass, and attach redacted after-fix runtime evidence before merging.
